prompt: When setting up a new Apache 2.4 configuration, which file is the primary configuration file by default?
explanation: The primary configuration file for the Apache 2.4 HTTP Server is `httpd.conf`. This file is the starting point for all configuration and is the file most administrators will edit to change global settings. "`apache2.conf`" might be present in some Debian-based distributions, but the default primary configuration file for Apache 2.4 is "`httpd.conf`".
